Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for opening bank accounts and accessing financial services
Comments: The national ID is mandatory for opening bank accounts under COBAC/BEAC KYC regulations and Law No. 2010/012. World Bank ID4D confirmed NID is mandatory for KYC/bank accounts. 36% of unbanked Cameroonians cite lack of ID as a barrier. BEAC requires biometric-based KYC (Unique Banking Identifier program).

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for accessing public healthcare services
Comments: National ID is accepted for healthcare access but not strictly mandatory as a barrier to care. World Bank ID4D noted ID is 'not a barrier if paying.' Healthcare facilities may request ID but patients can generally access care. Plans exist to link DHIS2 patient records with unique IDs but not yet implemented. ID is used for CNPS (social security) health benefits enrollment.
